purpose: #88 F4: the agreed ROM-only interactive demo for the M4 gate, and the button-driven ROMs for the F3 manual checklist. Not redistributed: the ROMs and licence files stay under target/test-roms.
selection: Homebrew Hub (hh3.gbdev.io API, gbdev/database) searched 2026-11-23: 657 GB game entries, 43 with a declared licence. Headers of the permissive ones were read; only four are ROM-only (0147 = 00, 0148 = 00): MaxPirate, GB Snake, madpew's Battlegrounds (no licence file in its repository) and PlantBoy (source repository deleted). The first two are pinned.

smoke: tests/demo_roms.rs runs each ROM headless like the frontend (17,556 M-cycles per frame), with no core error or STOP allowed. Both ROMs draw, then show new pictures after button presses. With the presses disabled both fail, so the check depends on input.
observed_2026_11_23: MaxPirate: splash to about frame 245; LCD off while loading until about frame 310; title animation; Start switches to play. Snake: one still picture until an arrow press, then 159 distinct pictures over the run.
m5_candidates: Small MBC1 games found in the same scan, for M5: Porklike (MIT), PostBot (MIT), JP (MIT), Domination (MIT); Tobu Tobu Girl (MIT code, CC BY 4.0 assets) is MBC1 with RAM and battery.
